svg.title: Use the terminal for an agent or a saved command
svg.desc: Three states of the same terminal keep the project path visible. At the shell prompt, claude starts the agent. Inside Claude Code, the researcher supplies an ordinary-language prompt and uses /exit to return. At the shell prompt again, just figures runs the saved plotting script without an LLM call.
svg.text: Commands go to the shell; prompts go to the agent
1. Start Claude Code from the shell
The shell starts the agent program
2. Give the agent a research task
Regenerate the main figure from the saved
estimates. Explain which files you used.
3. Repeat a saved task from the shell
Saved code runs without an LLM call
